metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: ZEPBEE crystallizes in the cubic crystal system with space group P m -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C60 H234 Gd32 N24 O138 6+,6(H1 O1 1-),24(C1 H4 O1),36(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1A (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2A (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3A (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1D (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3D (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1E (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2C (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3E (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1F (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3F (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1G (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2B (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3G (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1H (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3H (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1I (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3I (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1J (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3J (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1K (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3K (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd1B (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2M (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3B (Gd) has 7 O neighbors; Gd2N (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2O (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2L (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1C (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3C (Gd) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 96 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.603-5.096 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 89.13-165.89°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd32(OH)54(mda)12(NO3)12(H2O)24⊃(H2O)6](OH)6·24CH3OH·30H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 54 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 24 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 6 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
